title: Dream Craft
description:
A persistent RPG sandbox where the world is shaped by players!

Form factions. Forge alliances. Adventure is waiting.
body:
A persistent RPG sandbox where the world is shaped by players.
This server requires the Dreamcraft modpack to play.
Download it on Modrinth: https://modrinth.com/modpack/DreamcraftRPG

Form factions. Forge alliances. Break them.

Every player starts with land to claim. PvP is always on.

Explore a world filled with dungeons, bosses, and player-specific loot that resets every 18 hours. 

Relics, artifacts, and Apotheosis systems let you carve out a build that feels like yours, not the game’s.

Factions can create living towns, trade hubs, or fortified cities with MineColonies, 

Magic shifts with the seasons. Each of the twelve months, a different school of magic grows dominant while others fade. Fire rages in Emberrise. Ice crystallizes in Frostveil. The balance never stays still. What you do with the scrolls you collect during each season is up to you.

Engineer defenses, weapons, tools, and transportation with Create and Tetra.

This isn’t a server you visit.

It’s a world you carve your name into.

Join us at: dreamcraft.pals.rip and join the community [Discord:[ https://discord.gg/Mtr9H4n967) ]
For server news, updates and vidoes check out: https://wonderbit.xyz/games/Dreamcraft/
